provenance.paper: L. London and E. Fauchon-Jones, arXiv:1810.03550v2
provenance.source: published rendered paper plus the fresh independent Leaver continued-fraction solver
provenance.solver_source: scripts/kerr_leaver_solver.py: independent radial continued fraction and spheroidal angular eigenproblem
provenance.paper_convention: tilde{omega}=omega_r+i/tau; independent roots conjugated before fit
provenance.clean_room_scope: No LAL, PyCBC, TEOB implementation, author implementation, oracle-fitting, calibration files, waveform outputs, or public target binary used
provenance.historical_limit: The paper does not specify the historical training count or all GMVP selections; this is a bounded independent reconstruction.
provenance.count_hypothesis: N=61 is a metadata hypothesis inferred from public coefficient rounding, not a published fact.
provenance.count_uncertainty: A different historical training count, node ordering, hidden GMVP subset, precision, or fit preprocessing could produce different coefficients; this run does not identify those unpublished choices.

choices.grid_generation: fresh exact N=61 grid; each continuation seed is an earlier root on this same grid
choices.direct_alternative: omega=m/2+sum(c_k*kappa**(k+1)); residual multiplier kappa**(-1/2), sample weight 1/kappa; reported sensitivity only
choices.check_nodes: 33 fixed nodes theta=-pi/2+(i+0.37)*pi/33; no training seeds
choices.solver_certification: strict=True; reject converged=False, nonphysical roots, or estimated frequency error >=1e-9
choices.branch_recovery: fixed midpoint continuation only after a solver failure or jump; no fit-count adaptation

execution.next_check: inspect progress.json after each completed mode; final report.json is written after all selected modes

fit_result.grid_definition: exact fresh N=61 theta grid; no interpolation
